symbols.name: precision unit
symbols.meaning: $2^{-p}$, the size of one unit in the last place of a stored value.
symbols.quote: Write $h_p = 2^{-p}$ for the size of one unit in the last place; an error of $a$ units is an absolute error below $a\,h_p$.

symbols.name: log box size
symbols.meaning: $\log_2 T$, the base-two logarithm of the padded box size $T$, which counts the transform stages.
symbols.quote: Write $L=\log_2 T$, so $L\le b$; the letter $L$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: construction constant
symbols.meaning: The integer $2d\alpha^2$ fixed by the source's construction, which grows more slowly than $b$.
symbols.quote: Here $\gamma = 2d\alpha^2$ is the construction constant of the source; the letter $\gamma$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: ring-stage error
symbols.meaning: The error of the polynomial-ring convolution stage, in units of $h_p$, bounded by $5TL$.
symbols.quote: The normalized form scales this by $T/r$, where $r$ is the record length, so the stage error is $E_{\rm ring}=\frac{T}{r}(3L+2)$ units; since $r\ge1$ and $L\ge1$, $E_{\rm ring}<5TL$.

symbols.name: source-transform error
symbols.meaning: The error of the source transform stage, in units of $h_p$.
symbols.quote: Call the source-transform error $E_s$, in units of $h_p$.

symbols.name: scaled-result error
symbols.meaning: The error, in units of $h_p$, of the first scaled result $\tilde w$.
symbols.quote: call its error $E_w$, in units of $h_p$.

symbols.name: computed scaled result
symbols.meaning: The computed approximation of the scaled convolution $w$, the convolution of the digit arrays divided by $S$.
symbols.quote: The first multiplication by $S$, the product of the [Prime source lengths](prime-source-lengths.md), gives the scaled result $\tilde w$, which approximates $w$, the convolution of the digit arrays divided by $S$; call its error $E_w$, in units of $h_p$.

symbols.name: bilinear contraction
symbols.meaning: A bilinear map whose output norm is at most the product of its input norms.
symbols.quote: For a bilinear map $\mathcal{C}$ that is a contraction, $\|\mathcal{C}(f,g)\|\le\|f\|\,\|g\|$, and bilinearity gives $\mathcal{C}(f',g')-\mathcal{C}(f,g)=\mathcal{C}(f'-f,g')+\mathcal{C}(f,g'-g)$.

relations.quote: This step bounds the error of the [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md), which is computed from two forward synthetic transforms, a pointwise product and an opposite transform.
This analysis takes its guard widths from the [Guard-width bound](guard-width-bound.md), so every intermediate value is exact.
The [Phase twist](phase-twist.md) at each end of the ring map adds error too: this analysis bounds the error of the phase twist at each end by $4h_p$.
This analysis bounds every operand in the [Array norm](array-norm.md) by one, so each lies in the disk.

Products of approximate operands are [Bilinear map](bilinear-map.md)s, and this analysis bounds the error of each product by $\|f'-f\|\,\|g'\|+\|f\|\,\|g'-g\|$: each operand error is weighted by the norm of the other operand.
The stage bound includes the error of the [Opposite transform](opposite-transform.md) and of both forward transforms.
Here $T$ counts the entries of the [Padded transform box](padded-transform-box.md).
the factor $S$, the product of the [Prime source lengths](prime-source-lengths.md), reverses the division by $S$ left in $\tilde w$.
The bound uses the growth rule of [Little-o notation](little-o-notation.md) for $\gamma$: $\gamma=o(b)$.

The final scaling undoes the normalizations of the [Normalization scales](normalization-scales.md): $2^{2b+4}$ reverses the two digit scales, and the factor $S$, the product of the [Prime source lengths](prime-source-lengths.md), reverses the division by $S$ left in $\tilde w$.
Each scaling is exact on the integer [Grid numerator](grid-numerator.md) of each value, so it adds no error.
